label: Turkish female-hypnosis sweep (15 Oct 2026)
description: Turkish-language titles where an adult woman is hypnotized or spell-controlled. Existing categories only. Merges into existing cards via match_title.

records.title: Sıfır Dediğimde / On the Count of Zero
records.summary: Aslı, a final-year art student who lost a valuable borrowed book, is hypnotized by psychiatrist Dr. Melih to recover the memory; in the trance she meets a mysterious man, which sets off strange events in the real world.
records.note: Age not stated (a final-year university student, so presumably adult; flagged). Film — trance sessions run through the whole film.
records.provenance: Turkish hypnosis sweep, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; clinical wording)

records.title: Leyla ile Mecnun
records.summary: After an accident leaves Leyla with amnesia, a therapist hypnotizes her; in the trance she sees Aksakallı Dede, who tells her the man she loves is named Mecnun.
records.note: Age not stated (adult woman of marriageable age; flagged). Did not check whether Leyla and Mecnun marry or have children by the series end.

episodes.gist: A therapist hypnotizes amnesiac Leyla; in the trance Aksakallı Dede tells her the man she loves is Mecnun

records.provenance: Turkish hypnosis sweep, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; clinical wording)

records.title: Vuslat
records.mechanism: Hypnosis session by a psychologist, arranged by her son
records.summary: To learn the truth about his father, Kerem arranges with a psychologist to put his mother Alice into a hypnosis session to get her to talk.
records.note: Both press sources reproduce the same official synopsis, so they are not fully independent (conflict flag). Air date inferred from articles published the night of 24 Feb 2020.

episodes.gist: A psychologist hypnotizes Alice at her son Kerem's request so she will reveal what she knows about his father

records.provenance: Turkish hypnosis sweep, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; clinical wording)

records.title: Cin “Aşk Büyüsü”
records.mechanism: Love spell (büyü) to bind a woman's will
records.summary: After failing to win Esra, Musa turns to a love spell popularized on social media; it quickly takes effect on her, then drags Musa into disaster.
records.note: Ages not stated (adults; flagged). The sources don't say how far Esra's will is controlled. Outcomes not found. Released 26 Jul 2019; written and directed by Battal Karslıoğlu.
records.provenance: Turkish hypnosis sweep, 15 Oct 2026 PT (adults only; clinical wording)

records.title: The Protector
records.summary: Leyla falls under the Immortals' influence: under Faysal she endangers Hakan; then another Immortal takes over her mind and programs her as an assassin against Hakan, and she is killed.

episodes.gist: Under Faysal's influence, Leyla puts Hakan in danger
Another Immortal takes control of Leyla's mind and orders her to kill Hakan
Leyla's programming activates; she attacks Hakan, and Zeynep kills her in self-defense

records.note: All season 2 episodes were released the same day on Netflix. Leyla's death is per the Mental Block wiki only.
